cooldownRule: The only browser run was followed by at least 300 seconds of idle time, recorded as six completed 50-second waits. These runs are an extreme probe and are not included in the four-scale main benchmark series.
verdict: S-1M did not produce M-3. Generation, validation, position replay, and cash replay completed, but the unchanged backup JSON path hit RangeError: Invalid string length before the browser could import data and reach C-file saving. The failure remains a string-limit failure in B serialization; it cannot be attributed to the new chunked C-file implementation.
